verdict.rationale: Better Stack's incident-management page claims a trigger-based action: it can post a todo list when a new incident is triggered and route the incident to the right responder. Catalog/metadata can also drive escalation rules. Neither describes a general condition-based workflow engine for updates, reminders or field changes. Escalation policies are alerting rules (adjacent), and the API/Terraform are building blocks, so neither earns credit here. Missing for 10: a documented workflow builder with conditions on incident events, automated status updates, reminders, automated field changes, and any hands-on corroboration.
